title: Restate u9h's gate run for the yoh shape: ticfac run-epic in the container, not EpicReconcilerWorkflow
body: u9h (dha's live gate run) still says to run an epic 'through EpicReconcilerWorkflow', which yoh deleted. It is also now the only place yoh's acceptance (ticfac drives a cloud epic in the container; a killed orchestrator re-derives from the remote) is proven live. Its acceptance should name that run: SIGTERM flush of a startProcess'd orchestrator, adoption after a mid-run restart, waitForEvent timeout concluded from the branch.
